body.p: The Office Action mailed November 22, 2024 (hereinafter "Office Action") has been carefully reviewed, and Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration of the rejections of Applicant's claims, particularly in view of the remarks that follow.
Applicant acknowledges with thanks the Examiner's indication at page 12 of the Office Action that claims 10-12 are allowable over the prior art of record.

p.u: Response to Provisional Rejection of Claims for Non-statutory Double Patenting

body.p: In the Office Action at paragraph 5, claims 1, 5-9, and 13 were provisionally rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims 1-9 and 13 of co- pending U.S. Patent Application No. 17/758,679 in view of U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2021/0370779 Al to Ford (hereinafter, "Ford").

The Office Action noted that a timely filed terminal disclaimer in compliance with 37 C.F.R. § 1.321(c) or 37 C.F.R. § 1.321(d) may be used to overcome a nonstatutory double patenting rejection provided the conflicting patent is shown to be commonly assigned with the present application.

Without conceding the propriety of the nonstatutory double patenting rejections, but instead to expedite allowance of the present application, enclosed and submitted herewith is a Terminal Disclaimer over U.S. Patent Application No. 17/758,679, together with payment of the statutory disclaimer fee of $183.00 (specified in 37 C.F.R. § 1.20(d)) applicable to a large entity. Based on the submission of the accompanying Terminal Disclaimer, withdrawal of the claim rejections the ground of nonstatutory obviousness-type double patenting over U.S. Patent Application No. 17/758,679 is warranted, and is respectfully requested.
Based on the foregoing, all pending claims are patentably distinguished over the art, and in form and condition for allowance. The Examiner is requested to favorably consider the
foregoing, and to responsively issue a Notice of Allowance.

Although the present communication may include alterations to the application or claims, or characterizations of claim scope or referenced art, Applicant is not conceding in this application that previously pending claims are not patentable over the cited references. Rather, any alterations or characterizations are being made to facilitate expeditious prosecution of this application.

The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any fees associated with the filing of this correspondence to Deposit Account No. 50-1732, to the extent that such fees are not paid by other means (e.g., via credit card).
If any issues require further resolution, the Examiner is requested to contact the undersigned attorney at (919) 323-5029 to discuss same.
